unverifiable_exemptions: Seasonal use or rental (a term of not more than 125 consecutive days by a person with a permanent residence elsewhere) is exempt from the interest-bearing account section
coverage.summary: Applies to most residential rentals, including mobile homes. Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are exempt unless the tenant opts in by written request.
coverage.owner_conditions: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are exempt. The tenant can make the law apply 30 days after sending the landlord a written request.
coverage.other_conditions: The interest-bearing account section does not apply to seasonal rentals of 125 consecutive days or less by persons with a permanent residence elsewhere.

result.notes: I set landlord_size_condition to null. The 10-unit threshold only decides which kind of account the landlord may use to hold deposits, which is landlord conduct rather than a limit on covered buildings. The guide also states it inconsistently ('ten or less' vs '10 or more'). I set requires_unknown_facts to false because the law covers ordinary residential rentals. I added the seasonal-rental exclusion, which applies only to the account section, to unverifiable_exemptions. All values are supported by the D067 Security Deposits section.
